caveats: Within one situation the decision-time observable state is identical on every CRN seed (seeds differ only after t0), so negative and positive labels of the same wall share their trigger input; the CE learns the situation's wall probability, not a per-seed oracle.
Enabling wall_pressure_features or wall_release adds trigger parameters (w2_head.*, descriptor width): start from a fresh/u0 trigger state, not by strict-restoring an OFF trigger checkpoint mid-run.
The executors (run/confirm) and emit's real tape/branch layout were exercised only with CPU fakes; first cpuV use should be a single small screen job.
Tuning seeds use fresh salts walltune#<state_id>#r<k> (not the probe's selection seeds); confirmation seeds are verify_perseed's own.
